title: नवाधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 209 · The fires born of Brihaspati

summary.en: Markandeya names the fires born of Brihaspati and his wife, each with its own role in the sacrifice, such as Shamyu, the fire of the great offerings, and the fires invoked at the new and full moon.
summary.kn: ಬೃಹಸ್ಪತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅವನ ಪತ್ನಿಯಿಂದ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ, ಯಜ್ಞದಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಪಾತ್ರವಿರುವ ಅಗ್ನಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾರ್ಕಂಡೇಯರು ಹೆಸರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗೆ ಶಂಯು, ಅಮಾವಾಸ್ಯೆ ಪೌರ್ಣಮಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆಹ್ವಾನಿಸುವ ಅಗ್ನಿಗಳು.
summary.hi: मार्कण्डेय बृहस्पति और उनकी पत्नी से उत्पन्न अग्नियों के नाम बताते हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक की यज्ञ में अपनी भूमिका है, जैसे शंयु, और अमावस्या तथा पूर्णिमा पर आहूत अग्नियाँ।
summary.te: బృహస్పతి, అతని భార్య నుండి పుట్టిన, యజ్ఞంలో తమతమ పాత్ర ఉన్న అగ్నులను మార్కండేయుడు పేర్కొంటాడు, ఉదాహరణకు శంయువు, అమావాస్య పౌర్ణమిలలో ఆహ్వానించే అగ్నులు.
summary.ta: ப்ருஹஸ்பதிக்கும் அவர் மனைவிக்கும் பிறந்த, யாகத்தில் தனித்தனிப் பங்குள்ள அக்னிகளை மார்க்கண்டேயர் பெயரிடுகிறார்; உதாரணமாக ஶம்யு, அமாவாசை பௌர்ணமியில் அழைக்கப்படும் அக்னிகள்.
summary.ml: ബൃഹസ്പതിയിൽനിന്നും അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ പത്നിയിൽനിന്നും ജനിച്ച അഗ്നികളെ മാർക്കണ്ഡേയൻ പേരെടുത്തു പറയുന്നു; ഓരോന്നിനും യാഗത്തിൽ അതിന്റേതായ ധർമ്മമുണ്ട്. വലിയ ആഹുതികളുടെ അഗ്നിയായ ശമ്യു, അമാവാസിയിലും പൗർണ്ണമിയിലും വിളിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന അഗ്നികൾ എന്നിവ ഇതിൽപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.209; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
बृहस्पतेश्चान्द्रमसी भार्याभूद्या यशस्विनी ।
अग्नीन्साजनयत्पुण्यान्षडेकां चापि पुत्रिकाम् ॥

meaning.en: "Brihaspati's wife, the renowned Chandramasi, bore six holy fires and one daughter."

verses.text:
आहुतिष्वेव यस्याग्नेर्हविषाज्यं विधीयते ।
सोऽग्निर्बृहस्पतेः पुत्रः शंयुर्नाम महाप्रभः ॥

meaning.en: "The fire into whose oblations ghee is poured is Brihaspati's son, the greatly radiant Shamyu."

verses.text:
चातुर्मास्येषु यस्येष्ट्यामश्वमेधेऽग्रजः पशुः ।
दीप्तो ज्वालैरनेकाभैरग्निरेकोऽथ वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: "At the Chaturmasya rites, and in the ritual of the horse sacrifice where the first victim is offered, one fire alone, mighty, shines with many gleaming flames."

verses.text:
शंयोरप्रतिमा भार्या सत्या सत्या च धर्मजा ।
अग्निस्तस्य सुतो दीप्तस्तिस्रः कन्याश्च सुव्रताः ॥

meaning.en: "Shamyu's matchless wife was Satya, truthful and born of dharma. Their son was the blazing fire, and they had three daughters of firm vows."

verses.text:
प्रथमेनाज्यभागेन पूज्यते योऽग्निरध्वरे ।
अग्निस्तस्य भरद्वाजः प्रथमः पुत्र उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "The fire honored in a sacrifice with the first share of ghee is said to be Bharadvaja, his first son."

verses.text:
पौर्णमास्येषु सर्वेषु हविषाज्यं स्रुवोद्यतम् ।
भरतो नामतः सोऽग्निर्द्वितीयः शंयुतः सुतः ॥

meaning.en: "At all the full-moon rites ghee is held up in the ladle for the fire named Bharata, Shamyu's second son."

verses.text:
तिस्रः कन्या भवन्त्यन्या यासां स भरतः पतिः ।
भरतस्तु सुतस्तस्य भरत्येका च पुत्रिका ॥

meaning.en: "There were three other daughters, whose husband was that Bharata; Bharata's son was a fire, and he had one daughter named Bharati."

verses.text:
भरतो भरतस्याग्नेः पावकस्तु प्रजापतेः ।
महानत्यर्थमहितस्तथा भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: "Best of the Bharatas, the fire Bharata was the fire of Prajapati, and Pavaka too, was held in great honor."

verses.text:
भरद्वाजस्य भार्या तु वीरा वीरश्च पिण्डदः ।
प्राहुराज्येन तस्येज्यां सोमस्येव द्विजाः शनैः ॥

meaning.en: "Bharadvaja's wife was Vira, and Vira was the one who offers the funeral cakes. Brahmins say that ghee is slowly offered to him, as to Soma."

verses.text:
हविषा यो द्वितीयेन सोमेन सह युज्यते ।
रथप्रभू रथध्वानः कुम्भरेताः स उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "The one who is joined with Soma at the second offering is called Rathaprabhu, Rathadhvana and Kumbhareta."

verses.text:
सरय्वां जनयत्सिद्धिं भानुं भाभिः समावृणोत् ।
आग्नेयमानयन्नित्यमाह्वानेष्वेष कथ्यते ॥

meaning.en: "He produced Siddhi on the Sarayu, surrounded Bhanu with rays, and is said to be the fire always invoked at the calls to offering."

verses.text:
यस्तु न च्यवते नित्यं यशसा वर्चसा श्रिया ।
अग्निर्निश्च्यवनो नाम पृथिवीं स्तौति केवलम् ॥

meaning.en: "The fire who never fails in fame, splendor and glory is named Nishchyavana, and he praises the earth alone."

verses.text:
विपाप्मा कलुषैर्मुक्तो विशुद्धश्चार्चिषा ज्वलन् ।
विपापोऽग्निः सुतस्तस्य सत्यः समयकर्मसु ॥

meaning.en: "Sinless and free from stains, pure and blazing with flame, the fire Vipapa is his son, true in the rites of agreement."

verses.text:
आक्रोशतां हि भूतानां यः करोति हि निष्कृतिम् ।
अग्निः स निष्कृतिर्नाम शोभयत्यभिसेवितः ॥

meaning.en: "The fire who makes amends for creatures that cry out is called Nishkriti; when served, he brings splendor."

verses.text:
अनुकूजन्ति येनेह वेदनार्ताः स्वयं जनाः ।
तस्य पुत्रः स्वनो नाम पावकः स रुजस्करः ॥

meaning.en: "The fire by whose agency people in pain cry out here is his son, called Svana, the maker of ailments."

verses.text:
यस्तु विश्वस्य जगतो बुद्धिमाक्रम्य तिष्ठति ।
तं प्राहुरध्यात्मविदो विश्वजिन्नाम पावकम् ॥

meaning.en: "The fire who stands pervading the mind of the whole world is called Vishvajit by the knowers of the self."

verses.text:
अन्तराग्निः श्रितो यो हि भुक्तं पचति देहिनाम् ।
स यज्ञे विश्वभुङ्नाम सर्वलोकेषु भारत ॥

meaning.en: "The fire who dwells within and digests what living beings eat is named Vishvabhuj at the sacrifice, in all worlds, descendant of Bharata."

verses.text:
ब्रह्मचारी यतात्मा च सततं विपुलव्रतः ।
ब्राह्मणाः पूजयन्त्येनं पाकयज्ञेषु पावकम् ॥

meaning.en: "A celibate, self-controlled and of great vows is this fire, whom brahmins honor at the cooked-offering sacrifices."

verses.text:
प्रथितो गोपतिर्नाम नदी यस्याभवत्प्रिया ।
तस्मिन्सर्वाणि कर्माणि क्रियन्ते कर्मकर्तृभिः ॥

meaning.en: "The renowned fire named Gopati, whose beloved is a river, is the one in whom all rites are performed by the priests."

verses.text:
वडवामुखः पिबत्यम्भो योऽसौ परमदारुणः ।
ऊर्ध्वभागूर्ध्वभाङ्नाम कविः प्राणाश्रितस्तु सः ॥

meaning.en: "The terrible fire who drinks water as Vadavamukha is named Urdhvabhak, a seer, and he dwells in the vital breath."

verses.text:
उदग्द्वारं हविर्यस्य गृहे नित्यं प्रदीयते ।
ततः स्विष्टं भवेदाज्यं स्विष्टकृत्परमः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: "The fire in whose house an offering is always given facing north, and from whom ghee becomes well-offered, is called Svishtakrit, the supreme."

verses.text:
यः प्रशान्तेषु भूतेषु मन्युर्भवति पावकः ।
क्रोधस्य तु रसो जज्ञे मन्यती चाथ पुत्रिका ।
स्वाहेति दारुणा क्रूरा सर्वभूतेषु तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: "The fire who becomes wrath when beings are at peace is Manyu. From the essence of anger was born a daughter Manyati, called Svaha, fierce and cruel, who dwells in all creatures."

verses.text:
त्रिदिवे यस्य सदृशो नास्ति रूपेण कश्चन ।
अतुल्यत्वात्कृतो देवैर्नाम्ना कामस्तु पावकः ॥

meaning.en: "The fire whose match in beauty no one in the three heavens could find was named Kama by the gods, because he was without equal."

verses.text:
संहर्षाद्धारयन्क्रोधं धन्वी स्रग्वी रथे स्थितः ।
समरे नाशयेच्छत्रूनमोघो नाम पावकः ॥

meaning.en: "The fire called Amogha holds anger in joyful excitement, carrying bow and garland, standing in a chariot; he destroys enemies in battle."

verses.text:
उक्थो नाम महाभाग त्रिभिरुक्थैरभिष्टुतः ।
महावाचं त्वजनयत्सकामाश्वं हि यं विदुः ॥

meaning.en: "Greatly fortunate Uktha, praised with three uktha hymns, begot Mahavacha, whom they know as Sakamashva."
